svg.text: Title: Commo — 49 MHz AX.25 + LoRa 915 MHz Transceiver Cape (Rev S1)
MMBT2222A NPN BJT PA Class-A Driver
POWER SUPPLY (5V input filter, MCP1703 LDO, bypass cascade)
AFSK MODEM (MCP4921 TX DAC, LM393 RX demod, tone filters)
UART / SBUS DIGITAL (CMC, TVS, beads, inverter, mux)
SiK RFD900ux-SMT (915 MHz UHF telemetry -- relocated from XO 2026-09-21, see avionics/WBS.md)
ETHERNET 2nd PORT (ADIN1300 PHY + T-ETH isolation xfmr, JST-GH-4P line)
PB2-I PASSTHROUGH RAILS (PocketBeagle 2 Industrial P1 + P2)
=== Section: TPM (SLB9672, added 2026-07-26; binds to the PB2-I host -- SPI1 shared bus + TPM_IRQN/TPM_RSTN via P1/P2, no dedicated header) ===
